questions.stem: Place these fractions in order from smallest to largest: $\frac{3}{5}$, $\frac{1}{2}$, $\frac{7}{10}$.
questions.explanation: Converting to a common denominator of $10$: $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{5}{10}$, $\frac{3}{5} = \frac{6}{10}$, and $\frac{7}{10}$ stays the same. In order: $\frac{5}{10} < \frac{6}{10} < \frac{7}{10}$.
